feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Anti-data centre groups set to march in Edinburgh as part of Europe-wide protest
articles.summary: A coalition of 75 organisations opposed to plans for AI data centres in Scotland is set to march in Edinburgh this month.

articles.title: UK has 'new pair of eyes' in space as new military satellite enters orbit
articles.summary: The UK has a "new pair of eyes" in space after it launched a new military satellite into orbit, the Ministry of Defence (MoD) has announced.

articles.title: Man charged with murder of missing woman whose whereabouts remain unknown
articles.summary: A man has been charged with the murder of a missing woman whose whereabouts remain unknown.

articles.title: Critical incident declared after car 'damaged by gunfire' - with two arrested
articles.summary: A critical incident has been declared in Swansea after a car was damaged by gunfire, police said.

articles.title: Prince Harry to appeal after privacy lawsuit against Daily Mail publisher dismissed
articles.summary: Prince Harry and other household names are appealing a judge's decision dismissing their privacy lawsuit against a newspaper group.

articles.title: Amateur cricketer 'Clicky Ponting' banned for two years over viral cheating
articles.summary: An amateur cricketer dubbed 'Clicky Ponting' has been banned from the sport for two years over cheating during games.

articles.title: Katherine Ryan feels 'grief and relief' over Brand guilty verdict
articles.summary: Comedian Katherine Ryan has said she feels "grief and relief" after Russell Brand was convicted of rape and sexual assault.

articles.title: Double murderer given extra 22 years for historical sexual assaults
articles.summary: A former Royal Navy petty officer who is serving a life sentence for two murders has been jailed for a further 22 years for sexually assaulting three young naval recruits and a 14-year-old boy in the 1990s.

articles.title: Man jailed after he admitted murdering mother of seven 28 years ago
articles.summary: A man has been jailed for more than 10 years after he admitted to murdering a mother of seven who disappeared 28 years ago then disposing of her decomposed body in household waste.

articles.title: Andrew made more than £2,000 a month subletting Royal Lodge cottages
articles.summary: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor received more than £2,000 a month from renting out three cottages at his former Royal Lodge home, a report by the public spending watchdog has revealed.
